payload.summary: Dustin's working style and collaboration preferences, demonstrated across clptr4p and prior subprojects.
payload.source: ThinkTank session history, AGENTS.md operating principles, persistent user profile

claims.value: class-first, generalize-before-create: organize knowledge at class/umbrella level, generalize existing skills before adding new ones
claims.claim: the user prefers class-first organization: generalize existing skills/umbrellas before creating new ones

claims.value: treat rendered output and direct visual evidence as absolute truth over backend config (theme.json, DB styles) when they conflict
claims.claim: for frontend work, rendered output and canonical assets are ground truth over backend configuration

claims.value: review and remediate vulnerability and supply-chain findings before running builds, containers, or project code from third-party-based local stacks
claims.claim: third-party-based local stacks get security review before builds or code run

claims.value: values an honest, challenging collaborator over a polite agreeable one; wants the agent to speak up when stuck or looping
claims.claim: the user wants honest pushback and open disagreement substantiated with evidence, and immediate escalation when the agent is stuck

claims.value: procedures and workflows belong in skills (loaded when relevant); only facts applying to every session belong in persistent memory; task progress belongs on the kanban board
claims.claim: knowledge is separated into skills (procedures), memory (universal facts), and kanban (task state) -- never conflated
